provenance.note: Krishnagiri district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope krishnagiri-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-krishnagiri). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId): the Thenpennai's to the east, the Cauvery's Chinnar and Dodda Halla to the south-west. The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/krishnagiri-rivers/tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: Hosur City Municipal Corporation: water supply and sewerage
properties.supplyLpcd: 80 LPCD now against 135 LPCD (51.26 MLD) required for the sewerage scheme
properties.boreWells2025_26: 26 of 27 bore wells erected under the 15th Finance Commission grant (Rs.6.49 crore) and 16 under the general fund (Rs.1.60 crore); 2.25 MLD sourced through them
properties.sewageTreatment: No operating sewage treatment plant. Underground sewerage scheme to Hosur City Municipal Corporation: Rs.582.54 crore sanctioned (RAS G.O.Ms.No. 143 / MA&WS (MA2) / dt: 08.11.2023 for Rs.582.54 crore); Rs.135.81 crore spent (23.31%) as on 2026-06-17; sewage generated 24.727 MLD now, 43.117 MLD by 2054; Package I (zones 1 to 5), collection network 35%; Package II (zones 6 to 11), collection network 35%; Package III, the two treatment plants 63%. Second plant: Hosur Corporation STP, 20.13 MLD (under construction) at ''Ramanaikken' (trade press, as printed); no revenue village of that name in the TNGIS register, so no point is drawn'; progress: SBR basin 1 and 2: walkway concrete under progress. CCT: second-lift wall concrete completed.

properties.name: Krishnagiri Municipality: sewerage
properties.sewerageAsPrinted: There is no under ground drainage system in Krishnagiri Municipality.
properties.registerStp: On the TNPCB register as 'Sewage treatment plant of Krishnagiri Municipality' (Red, Large, consent year 2017, Agasipalli); the municipality's sewerage page says the town has no underground drainage, and a sewer line along NH-48 is being laid (NHAI permission request). Whether the plant operates is not stated by any page read.
